sources: icarus-home-main/app/concepts/_shared/tokens.ts (the homepage's palette, lifted from the same theme)
meta.rule: Violet is the one command color: current action, selection, focus, primary command, nothing else. Hover stays flat. Nothing is set in capitals except the wordmark and VALORANT.

background.use: The canvas and every page. Zinc-950.

raised.use: Raised chips, borders, muted fills. Zinc-800.

input.use: Field edges, one step above border. Zinc-700.

foreground.use: Text and the white logo. Zinc-50.

muted.use: Body copy on the site, secondary text in the app, resting icons. Zinc-400.

dim.use: Small labels above headings, version lines, footers. Zinc-500.

violet.use: Fills, buttons, the violet mark. Violet-700.

violetInk.use: App only: thin lines, glyphs, small text on dark, where the fill is too dark to read. Violet-500.

violetDeep.use: Text selection; the dark end of the halftone ramp. Violet-900.

lavender.use: Site only: icon tint in chips, the bright end of the halftone ramp. Violet-300.

halftoneRamp.note: The site's DitherFire/DitherLight shaders color each dot on this ramp by light intensity; the sun also mixes toward a silver ramp (#252530 -> #7a7a8a -> #e8e7f2).
